fee_notes: New Image360 Center: $40,000; MatchMaker Center: $45,000; Advantage/Additional/IDB Centers: $10,000; Existing Center purchase: $25,000. Veterans and first responders receive 50% discount on new Image360 or MatchMaker. Legacy transfer discounted to $5,000 in 2025. Conversion from SBT/Signs Now: no fee.
raw_excerpt: You must pay us a $40,000 initial franchise fee when you sign the Franchise Agreement if you are developing a new Image360 Center... If you are purchasing an existing Center, you must pay us an initial franchise fee of $25,000... If you are purchasing a franchise for an Advantage Center or an IDB Center, your initial franchise fee will be $10,000... You must pay us an initial franchise fee of $45,000 if you are purchasing a franchise for a MatchMaker Center.
